How to read P/E and ROE

P/E compares share price with earnings per share. A lower number alone does not establish that a stock is inexpensive; losses can make the ratio unavailable.

ROE compares profit with shareholders' equity. Debt, one-off gains, and industry differences can change its meaning.

— means unavailable. Ratio coverage appears when the certified financial index loads. Missing ratios are excluded from P/E and ROE filters.

Open a company to see each measure's source, scope and date before comparing stocks.

🎓 Institutional Setup Playbook & Pattern Anatomy
Master the quantitative mechanics of Minervini Volatility Contraction, Pocket Pivots, Stage 2 Trend Templates, and mathematical 3:1 position sizing. Screens identify candidates using the listed proxy criteria; full pattern conditions require further research.
🌀 Minervini Volatility Contraction Pattern (VCP) Mark Minervini
  • ● Prior Advancing Stage: Stock must have gained at least +30% to +100% before entering the base.
  • ● Diminishing Volatility: Contractions compress from wide to tight (e.g. 15% → 7% → 3%).
  • ● Volume Dry-Up: As base tightens, volume reaches multi-week lows (supply exhaustion).
  • ● Cheat Pivot Buy Point: Enter as price breaches the highest pivot of the final contraction with expanding volume.
Screener criteria: Dist ≥ -4%, Mom ≥ 80, Vol ≤ 1.5x
⚡ Pocket Pivot Accumulation Morales & Kacher
  • ● Constructive Base: Occurs within or coming out of a healthy consolidation base.
  • ● Key MA Support: Price bounces cleanly off or reclaims the 10-day or 20-day EMA.
  • ● Institutional Volume Signature: Volume MUST be higher than the largest DOWN volume bar in the prior 10 days.
  • ● Early Entry Edge: Positions you inside the base before the obvious 52W breakout occurs.
Screener criteria: Vol Surge ≥ 1.5x, Dist ≥ -8%
📈 Stan Weinstein Stage 2 Momentum Stan Weinstein
  • ● Upward Sloping 200 MA: The 30-week (200-day) moving average must be definitively sloping upwards.
  • ● Moving Average Stack: Price > 50 EMA > 200 EMA (bullish alignment).
  • ● Higher Highs & Higher Lows: Pullbacks find solid support at rising moving averages.
  • ● Institutional Sponsorship: High relative strength score vs broader index (Nifty 50).
Screener criteria: Dist ≥ -15%, Momentum ≥ 70

About Stockerboard

What guides us

Vision

Make understanding Indian companies and stocks simple, transparent, and accessible to everyone.

Mission

Turn complex financial and market data into clear, trustworthy, beginner-friendly insights that help investors investigate companies and make better-informed decisions.

🛡️ Statutory Disclosure & Disclaimer:
1. SEBI Regulatory Status & Non-Advisory Notice: Stockerboard (stockerboard.com) is a self-directed educational computational research and quantitative analytics platform. Neither Stockerboard nor its operators are registered as Research Analysts under the SEBI (Research Analysts) Regulations, 2014, nor as Investment Advisers under the SEBI (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013. All quantitative screeners, technical chart overlays, strategy tags (e.g. Minervini VCP, Pocket Pivot, Stage 2), and behavioral decision journals are algorithmic and mathematical in nature. Nothing on this platform constitutes an offer, solicitation, or recommendation to buy, sell, or hold any security, or financial product. We do not run paid advisory groups, Telegram/WhatsApp tip channels, or portfolio management services.

2. Mandatory SEBI Standard Risk Warning: Investment in securities market are subject to market risks. Read all the related documents carefully before investing. Educational research only, independent computational platform, and certification from NISM in no way guarantee performance of the intermediary or provide any assurance of returns to investors.

3. Exchange Data Attribution & Limitations (NSE & BSE India): All equity quotes, bhavcopy settlement prices, volume surges, and corporate actions are derived from publicly accessible, official End-of-Day (EOD) Bhavcopy publications and regulatory corporate filings published by the National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) and BSE Limited (BSE). Stockerboard does not provide real-time, low-latency, or streaming tick data; all metrics are calculated on an EOD closing basis. 'NSE', 'NIFTY 50', 'BSE', and 'SENSEX' are registered trademarks of their respective exchanges. Stockerboard is an independent computational research engine and is not endorsed by, sponsored by, or affiliated with NSE or BSE.

4. Government of India DPDP Act (2023) & IT Act (2000) Data Privacy: Guest watchlists and journal records use browser storage. Optional signed-in watchlist sync uses Firebase; hosting and analytics services may process request data. Local journal records remain in this browser. Signed-in watchlists may also have a cloud copy. We do not collect or store brokerage trading credentials or personal bank records. Clear browser site data to remove local records. Use the account deletion control to request removal of synced watchlist data; this requires a successful service response.
